correctness.rationale: Classify omitted vertices U=A\X and W=B\X. For U,W both nonempty, all edges UxW are mandatory; any other selected edge is removable, so canonical covers with size m+n-a-b+ab, count binom(m,a)binom(n,b). If U nonempty,W empty, each omitted vertex must select exactly one incident edge; selected B vertices all indispensable iff its function U->B is nonconstant, giving n^a-n choices. Symmetric degeneration gives m^b-m, and all-vertex selection is unique. Subtract overlap of a=1/b=1 to count minimum covers, rewrite exponent m+n-1+(a-1)(b-1), and maximize product for terminal gaps. Direct definition exhaustively classified 575,744 candidate subsets across K2,2 K2,3 K2,4 K3,3 K3,4. Independent paper Claim13 gives prior nondegenerate structural trichotomy but not the degenerate function counts.

final_claim: For every complete bipartite K_{m,n}, m,n>=2, the full labelled-subset enumerator of inclusionwise minimal strong total covers is the double binomial sum over a,b>=1 plus z^(m+n)[1+sum_a binom(m,a)(n^a-n)+sum_b binom(n,b)(m^b-m)]. It determines the exact number of minimum covers, all attainable cardinalities, unique all-edge maximal cover for m,n>=3 and arbitrarily long terminal gaps.
